'''Four Kings''' can refer to the following:

*[[Four Kings]] - a village in [[Andor]].
*[[Four Kings Road]] - a road that runs from [[Kore Springs]] to Four Kings.
*[[Battle of Four Kings]] - a battle fought during the [[War of the Hundred Years]].
*''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 32|Four Kings in Shadow]]'' - the thirty-second chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
